decisions.label: Paired-End Sequencing
decisions.description: A DNA sequencing strategy where a single read is initiated from each end of a DNA fragment.

verification.note: NCIT:C150423 Paired-End Sequencing; label describes the sequencing technique rather than the library layout property, but this is the NCIT term that captures paired-end as a library/sequencing design. Best available match for the 'Paired-end' NGS Library Layout value.

decisions.label: Single-indexed Sequencing
decisions.description: An indexed sequencing method that includes one index read.

verification.note: NCIT:C165444 Single-indexed Sequencing; label adds 'Sequencing' qualifier. In this context 'Single-indexed' refers to a library with a single barcode/index rather than dual-indexed, which NCIT:C165444 correctly describes. Best available match.
